trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one pops on its own once the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to hunt directly. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed for it. The real gate is A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, so treat every other trophy in this guide as the route to this one.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
Finish A Long Road (100% completion) last if anything is left.
The platinum pops automatically.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Play the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, to the end and it pops when the mission closes. It is the game's opening mission, so every player gets it within the first hour.
steps: Start Chapter 1.
Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1; the trophy pops as the game rolls into Chapter 2, right after the first mission of the new chapter, What's in the Bag?, begins. Nothing optional is needed for it.
steps: Play through all Chapter 1 main missions.
Start the first Chapter 2 mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Work through Chapter 2's main missions until the chapter closes; the pop lands as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is also where the game opens up, so use it to start scanning vehicles and animals for the 100% checklist.
steps: Play through all Chapter 2 main missions.
Start the first Chapter 3 mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3's main missions; it pops once you have played the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Side quests in Chapter 3, like Andy's, Randy's and Tyrone's chains, can wait until after the story.
steps: Play through all Chapter 3 main missions.
Play the first two Chapter 4 main missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 4's main missions; the pop comes after the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. By this point the optional mission that unlocks bank vault robberies should also be on your map, which sets up the robbery trophies.
steps: Play through all Chapter 4 main missions.
Finish the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The story's gold. Play the campaign to its last mission and finish it; the trophy pops with the ending. Sources word the finale differently, PowerPyx ties it to the mission Starting From Zero, while other lists describe the same finale as Chapter 5, so follow the story to its end rather than a chapter number. After the credits the game drops you back into free-roam for cleanup.
steps: Play the story to its final mission.
Finish the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during Chapter 2 when you finish the main mission Breakfast Run. Just keep playing the story; there is no way to skip past it or fail it permanently.
steps: Reach Chapter 2.
Finish the main mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during Chapter 3 when you finish the main mission The Cartel Heist, one of the story's big set-pieces. No preparation or side content is needed before it.
steps: Reach Chapter 3.
Finish the main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during Chapter 4 when you finish the main mission Child's Play. Keep following the pink main-mission markers and it unlocks on its own.
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Finish the main mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during Chapter 4 when you finish the main mission Headliners. Like every story trophy, it cannot be missed and needs no side content.
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Finish the main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during Chapter 4 when you finish the main mission VCIA Takedown, the airport set-piece. The mission also introduces you to VCIA, the airport you will come back to for the Catch Me If You Can trophy.
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Finish the main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during Chapter 5 when you finish the main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the last story trophies before the finale, so by now you should be deep into the endgame.
steps: Reach Chapter 5.
Finish the main mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the real platinum gate. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but anything you do during the story already counts toward it. The thresholds are forgiving, roughly 60% of true completion: most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required. The big numbers are 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, any 70 of 80 challenges, any 100 optional missions, and 300 stunts. The only categories that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable, so clean it up in free-roam after the credits.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion).
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals as you play.
Complete any 70 of 80 challenges and any 100 optional missions.
Clear the categories that need everything: robberies, shooting ranges, drone races, underwater discoveries, Bret's quests.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. They come in four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. You can mix the kinds freely, and flying under bridges is the quickest way to stack them. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
steps: Pick the easiest kind first: under-the-bridge flights.
Do any 250 stunts across the four kinds.
Track progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. The tracker counts fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check what you have done under Progress, then Activities. The story introduces most of them by itself, and the rest get marked on the map as blue dumbbell icons when you unfog areas, so this usually pops on its own while you work on everything else.
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see the 9 types.
Do one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race win, a stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. The challenges are not very hard, and playing them also levels up your Focus, which helps with the Gunslinger trophy. Work through every range and gold each of its challenges; the 100% checklist also needs all of them, so this is not optional for the platinum.
steps: Visit all 12 shooting range locations.
Earn gold in every one of the 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; there are 42 drone races in total, so you can pick the easiest race at each spot. Drone races also count as race wins for other trophies and are needed in full for the 100% checklist, so treat them as a core activity rather than a one-off.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win at least one race at every location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations in the game, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count, so fold this into the Top Fun and shooting-range work and pick the races you find easiest.
steps: Win races at 20 different locations.
Drone races and race challenges count too.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline. After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his quests and beat him in the fishing challenge when it comes up. Fishing also counts toward the activity types for Master of None.
steps: Finish Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui to meet Cal.
Wait for Cal's text with the purple fishing marker.
Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. There are 4 video games in the world: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck sits in arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game once; beating every challenge inside it is not required. Pick whichever you enjoy most.
steps: Play any of the 4 video games (3 at the home TV, 1 at arcade machines).
Finish all of its levels once to reach the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you will get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Her 5 quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story, so there is no rush.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and take Andy's call.
Go to her address in Belville.
Complete her 5 quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It gets marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you to 7 shipwrecks; find each underwater treasure with the metal detector and bring it back to him. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or under Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3, so he is not missable.
steps: Finish Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, then take Kenton's call.
Clear his 7 shipwreck treasure sets and bring each haul back.
Return to his shop whenever he calls for the next set.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. His 5 quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.
steps: Finish Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete his 5 quests, ending with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers, but note that only certain questlines count. Confirmed to count are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street-racing mentorship) and Pilot Pete (the delivery runs). Many other optional questlines do not count, including Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie, so do not assume every side quest moves this counter. Every stranger is still findable in free-roam after the story, and you can watch the count on the trophy tracker in the trophy list.
steps: Find stranger questlines in the open world.
Finish 8 strands that count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed.
Check the count on the trophy tracker.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's car-delivery questline. It gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to deliver. Track it under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars for you in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street anywhere. When you scan or enter a car he wants, you get a prompt to deliver it to his garage, marked with a green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Delivering in good condition pays more. Sports cars show up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around.
steps: Finish Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Open Randy's Wish List under Map > Robberies.
Deliver all 16 sports cars to his garage.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is only available as Jason. It gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point you to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City; go there and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives you his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good, and that is the one that pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: Play as Jason after Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple.
Finish Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts as 2 meditations at the same location. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. WARNING, the only possibly missable trophy in the game: there is a meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 that disappears after that chapter. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation adds 1 to the counter but is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy actually needs it. Do it anyway while you can; it costs nothing. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, and you cannot do the final spot until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
steps: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: after mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony.
Meditate at all 18 spots, with both characters where possible.
Track progress in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline, exclusive to Jason. It gets marked automatically some time after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. Clean one-shot kills leave animals in pristine condition and pay more, but are not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck; there are 15 Target Decks in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them. Which exact animal pops this trophy is still being confirmed, so work through Bret's quests in order.
steps: Play as Jason after Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and take Bret's text.
Meet Bret in Lummox County (quest Veteran Hunted).
Hunt the animals he marks and bring them to him.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered across Leonida. You do not need all 18, just any 3 full sets, so pick the sets whose cards cluster near places you already visit for other trophies. Cards are a pure collectible hunt: no mission or activity unlocks them, so fold the search into your map-unfogging and WAiNK scanning routes.
steps: Find collectible cards around Leonida.
Complete any 3 full sets out of 18.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan any 100 locations in the world. Hold up and then R1 to scan what you are looking at. There are more than 100 scannable spots, split across 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags, and any mix of them counts. The same WAiNK app scans vehicles for the Whip It Good and 100% checklist counts, so scan everything you pass while exploring.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold up, then R1 to scan).
Scan any 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures or tags.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. Track them under Progress, then Challenges; scrolling over one shows a checkmark when it is done. Most of them complete naturally while you work on other trophies and the 100% checklist, which itself needs any 70 of 80, so leave this for late and then pick off the easiest ones you have left. There are 10 more challenges than the checklist needs, so you can skip the hardest ones entirely.
steps: Play normally; most challenges complete on their own.
Open Progress > Challenges to see what is left.
Finish any 50, picking the easiest remaining ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when the two characters can free-roam together; call your partner by holding right and pressing triangle. Cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars, then break out of the red heat radius, not just the flashing search area. A fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works well, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape route because police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. This also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, and during bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.
steps: After Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call your partner (hold right + triangle).
Cause trouble until you hit a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone, for example through the Ambrosia train tunnel.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when the pair can free-roam together. Hit 3 robbery targets, the green icons on the map, without ever dropping the wanted level, and keep it at the flashing red-blue stage rather than the full red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Rob a couple of items in each store and break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs; if you leave the first store before police arrive you may need a 4th shop. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop, so keep going until it lands.
steps: After Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call your partner.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing the wanted level.
Loot each store properly and wait for the delayed pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone: hold up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. Scanning is enough, you never need to drive a vehicle to discover it. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops naturally on the way there. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold up).
Scan passing vehicles with R1 until 100 are discovered.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar in the top left. Buff your focus first by eating or drinking, or washing your face or showering at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch the slow-time window. Line up 5 enemies, ideally the criminals at a gang operation, and drop them fast without missing; an assault rifle like the Duke 556 is more accurate than pistols and SMGs. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game and may pop on its own.
steps: Buff focus (food, drink, Adrenaline) and wear body armor.
Find 5 enemies grouped together, for example at a gang operation.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3) and drop all 5 in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at one of the departure terminals at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. It has to be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge; the planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest is the one at departure terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for the plane, and use the stairs next to the boarding bridge, where a door leads directly into it. Inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly away. The pop is delayed until you are about 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but crossing the airfield is faster.
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the plane docked at terminals E3/E4.
Board it through the stairs by the boarding bridge.
Take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They are parked at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the air base. Drive in through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so bring armor and be ready for a fight on the way in.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Enter the base and reach the tanks in the south.
Drive a Rhino tank and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean, without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies on the map with green icons in unfogged areas. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it, which would trip the alarm. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently and needs no equipping. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Finish Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun.
Loot the safe with its code, destroy the footage, disable the alarm, leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, where you wait at a cafe: it teaches the method and counts as your first vault. Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch a guard carry a briefcase of cash inside, then slip in while the vault is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hand off a bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani, the fence unlocked in Chapter 3, for tips about security vans at $10,000 each; if you have not done his earlier quests yet, rob 2 Payday Loans first. Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level instantly, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way. A single bank can pay up to $205,000, making this the best endgame money-maker.
steps: Finish Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani ($10,000 each).
Tail a van to a bank, rob the open vault with your partner, escape. Repeat 5 times.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easy route is the same Chapter 4 optional mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is: robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank. To get it earlier, watch for armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open. The trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius, so use a Pay 'n' Spray if needed. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests.
steps: Either do the bank-vault intro mission (it counts), or find an armored truck near a bank.
Blow its back door with a sticky bomb and take the cash.
Escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. Every area still covered in black fog on the map needs visiting, and the fastest way is by plane: fly over each fogged patch until the map turns visible. Fold this into your other travel, scanning vehicles and WAiNK locations as you fly and drive around, and check the map often for the last dark corners.
steps: Take a plane up over Leonida.
Fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is fully visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many get marked automatically from story progress. For this trophy you only need one per gang, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so you will pop this on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs, where scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
steps: Find illegal operations (yellow icons) on the map.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Track progress in Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one-off. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar, looking out over the view. The trophy pops once you have had the drink in the right spot, so do not walk off with it before drinking.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car, the blue Banshee, from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after you have the Key Cloner, unlocked in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the car, drive forward and out through the glass; the pop is slightly delayed and lands once you have driven further down the street. Any other car will not count, it has to be that blue Banshee, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs).
Go to the showroom in south Vice City and steal the blue Banshee.
Drive it straight through the showroom window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which gets marked automatically. Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first, you need them to blow the safe. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway office. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for the rest, so this is not missable.
steps: Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation.
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Take the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe loot, then escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check the level under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength, the heart icon. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise Strength by working out: buy a fitness club membership and always go together with your partner, holding right and pressing triangle to call them. While you actively train with one character, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Filter for fitness clubs on the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon; there are plenty across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
steps: After Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership.
Work out with your partner beside you so both train at once.
Reach maximum Strength on both characters at the same time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something counts. The profile runs from Professional, for stealthy objectives and clean escapes, through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, with Irredeemable as a permanent status if you keep using excessive violence, which makes cops more aggressive, so avoid that one. This mostly happens on its own while you do robberies and fight through the other trophies. If it is still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI.
Play normally; robberies and encounters all count.
Check the 500 count on the trophy itself and farm the rest if needed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch, and this guide will not invent one. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue; the description, Second time's the charm, points at succeeding on a second attempt at something. Until a method is confirmed, play the prologue's Payday Loans content, watch for a moment that lets you retry, and do not chase this early. It may pop on its own during normal play, and the guide will be updated here once a source confirms the trigger.
steps: No confirmed method yet (PowerPyx, 19 Nov 2026).
Believed to involve the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Play the prologue content and watch for a second-chance moment.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and go alone. Sometimes you will find a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside; do that and the trophy pops. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.
steps: Go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2AM.
Look for the blinking car; if absent, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, help the woman it drops, return to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch, and this guide will not invent one. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and believes it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, a melee drive-by. The description, Bowl 'em over, fits knocking people down from a moving bike. Until a method is confirmed, try melee kicks at pedestrians from a motorcycle and watch for the pop; it may also come naturally during other trophies.
steps: No confirmed method yet (PowerPyx, 19 Nov 2026).
Believed to be a melee kick from a moving motorcycle.
Try kicking enemies while riding and watch for the pop.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts in total; you do not need to bring it all at once. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew: that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. This comes naturally while you do all the robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, though those only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
steps: Finish Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 total to a fence (Yasmani pays most).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so the money goes quickly once you start kitting out cars and weapons. This pops naturally if you buy gear for the other trophies.
steps: Spend $100,000 across any shops.
Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, which cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses; you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. There are 4 more garages that come from the story, but only the 8 bought ones count. Robberies are the quick way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.
steps: Finish Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.
Open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Buy all 8 garages ($160,000 total).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses; it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you wherever you are. You need enough garages first, see Little Boxes, because each garage adds one or more parking spots for registered vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so pick cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
steps: Finish Chapter 2 mission Moses to get the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first so you have parking spots.
Take 10 stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and Register each one.
